exposure: women who required conversion from neuraxial analgesia to general anesthesia
cervical dilation at time of epidural placement
women just before and after each case included
outcome: conversion to general anesthesia for urgent cesarean
cohort: 3,300 women with labor epidural analgesia who delivered after 37 gestational weeks by urgent cesarean at Port Royal Maternity unit between 2012 and 2017.
finding: Suboptimal epidural analgesia significantly increased the risk for conversion to general anesthesia for urgent cesarean in women with labor epidural analgesia.
